verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is a managed ClickHouse database. It documents several agent-adjacent features: an MCP server that lets coding agents run SQL, read-only isolated compute for agents, full query logging, and table/column-level roles. None of these is a natural-language question interface for business users, and none is a semantic layer that grounds answers and prevents hallucinated joins. They are building blocks or adjacent controls, not the capability itself, so no evidence shows the product delivers this story.
